title: VIP mailbox AiTM phishing
iocs: Inbox rule: 'If from CFO then delete'
notes: User clicked a DocuSign lure. Risk detection: unfamiliar properties + anonymous IP. Need token revoke and mailbox-rule hunt.

title: Endpoint encryption on FILESRV01
assets: FILESRV01, jump host ADM-17, domain account svc-backup
notes: Mass file rename on finance share. Backup job failed 40 minutes earlier. Patient zero still unknown.

title: PowerShell cradle from Excel add-in
notes: EDR prevented full payload. Need org-wide hash hunt and mail quarantine.

title: Credential stuffing against VPN portal
iocs: 38 successful logins from 6 residential proxy ranges
notes: Leaked-credential list matched against breach corpus. No MFA enforced on legacy VPN group. Recommend forced password reset + MFA rollout.

title: Misconfigured S3 bucket exposing customer exports
iocs: Bucket ACL changed to public-read on 2026-08-30
GetObject calls from unknown IP range 45.14.x.x
CloudTrail gap of 12 hours before discovery
notes: Discovered via external researcher disclosure. ~3,200 customer export files potentially accessed. Legal/notification review required.

title: Malicious OAuth app granted mailbox scope
assets: Entra ID tenant, marketing team mailboxes (14 users)
iocs: Consent granted with Mail.Read, offline_access scopes
Refresh token used from 3 distinct ASNs post-grant
notes: User approved consent prompt from a phishing email disguised as a survey tool. App registration not verified publisher. Revoke consent, audit tenant-wide app grants.

title: DNS tunneling exfiltration attempt
notes: Flagged by DNS analytics for volume anomaly. Endpoint isolated pending forensic image. Suspected staged exfil of source-control archive.

title: Insider data exfiltration via personal cloud storage
iocs: 42GB uploaded to personal Dropbox in final 48 hours
USB mass storage device connected twice prior
Customer contract folder accessed outside normal pattern
notes: Flagged by DLP after resignation notice. Legal and HR engaged. Need full activity timeline for last 30 days before offboarding completes.

title: SQL injection on customer portal login
iocs: UNION SELECT payloads in login POST body
notes: WAF rule bypass via encoded payload. Evidence of successful data dump on users table. Take portal offline for patching, rotate DB credentials.

title: Supply-chain compromise via CI/CD pipeline dependency
assets: GitLab CI runner, build artifact registry, production containers
iocs: Malicious postinstall script in updated npm package
Outbound beacon from build runner to pastebin-mirror[.]io
Modified build hash mismatch against signed baseline
notes: Detected via SBOM diff during routine audit, not real-time alerting. Need to determine blast radius across all services using the dependency and rotate CI secrets.

title: Kubernetes cluster privilege escalation
iocs: Pod created with hostPID: true and privileged: true
kubectl exec from unrecognized service account token
notes: Misconfigured RBAC allowed default service account to create privileged pods. No confirmed host compromise yet. Recommend policy enforcement (OPA/Gatekeeper) and audit log review.

title: Volumetric DDoS against public API gateway
iocs: Source IPs spoofed, amplification via open DNS resolvers
notes: Mitigated via upstream scrubbing service. No data impact. Post-incident review of rate-limiting and CDN failover thresholds recommended.
